**Quran 113:1:** ﴿Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak.﴾

**Commentary:** (The daybreak) means the dawn (al-subh).
From the evil of what He created: from living beings, whether accountable or not, and from inanimate things, such as poison and other things.

Tafsir al-Jalalayn on Surah 113, verse 3:

﴿And from the evil of the darkness when it settles﴾, i.e., the night when it grows dark, and the moon when it sets.

﴿And from the evil of the blowers﴾ of knots, the sorceresses who blow ﴿into the knots﴾ that they tie in the thread, blowing on them with something they say, without saliva. And al-Zamakhshari said: with it, like the daughters of Labid mentioned above.

﴿And from the evil of the envier when he envies﴾: he who shows his envy and acts upon what it requires, such as Labid, mentioned earlier, from among the Jewish envious ones toward the Prophet (ﷺ). The mention of these three [categories], which encompasses what He created after them, is because of the intensity of their evil.
